Frozen shared template limitation: tests/test.sh:48-55 treats any HTTPError, including 404, as ready. Generated app-restart.sh at tests/test.sh:152-183 sends SIGTERM but never requires the old process group to exit or the new PID to be alive; a response from the old listener satisfies probe_ready. Static source proof; no resistant-process runtime test performed.
quality.counterexample: A submitted server keeps its in-memory records and ignores SIGTERM. The replacement cannot bind port 3000, but the old server still answers /api/health; restart_app reports success and later readback falsely appears durable.
quality.suggested_fix: In shared template policy, require old-group termination, new-PID liveness and a successful response from the replacement process; treat failed replacement as tool error rather than persistence credit.

quality.suggested_fix: Repair the shared restart helper to verify process replacement, then remeasure the hro_restart witness against a deliberately resistant in-memory app.
